Standalone note example

2026-08-06 · demonstrates the drop-in path

This file is a complete HTML document with its own <style> block. It does not use the site's style.css, does not have the site's topbar, and was not reformatted to get here. It was written, saved into pages/notes/, and built.

The build injected three things into its <head> — the noindex tag, the web app manifest link, and the service-worker registration — and changed nothing else. That is what makes it readable offline alongside the rest.

The listing metadata came from the comment block above the doctype:

<!--note
date: 2026-08-06
title: Standalone note example
summary: One line for the listing.
-->
<!doctype html>

That block is optional. Without it the title falls back to <title> and the summary to <meta name="description">; only the date has no fallback, and a note without one sorts last.
